name: git-ai (graft)
description: Hosts Git repositories for fleets of coding agents, with sparse clones, server-side history, queue-free landing and conflict resolution via the graft CLI.

skills.name: Sparse Clone
skills.description: Fetches single objects and sparse trees so each agent materializes only the paths it needs with graft clone or graft sparse.

skills.name: Land Without a Queue
skills.description: Rebases a change onto the current tip and lands it with compare-and-swap, batching concurrent lands on one branch.

skills.name: Automatic Conflict Resolution
skills.description: Resolves conflicting lands with an LLM or deterministic resolver and lands the result only if your verify command passes.

skills.name: Server-Side History
skills.description: Runs blame, path history, ancestry and code search on the server, caching results once per commit for every agent.

skills.name: Test and Revert Culprit
skills.description: Tests the branch tip after landing, bisects any failure and reverts the change that broke it with graft-verify.
